ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.14). Bug-fix and polish iteration. The tab now fills the screen above the 35 px main-tab bar. The Work combo opens directly under its button, clamps to the screen, flips above the button when there is no room below, keeps Any first, excludes the already-selected WorkType and still shows at most 10 rows with a thin scrollbar. A three-state Filter: Line/Palette/Both control (default Line) scopes the Work filter: Line filters pawn rows only, Palette filters palette chips only, Both filters both; Not inverts it wherever it applies; Pawn search always filters only pawn rows. Exact WorkType identity is matched, so Patient does not match PatientBedRest. Lane cards are 135 px wide. Passion icons use one shared resolver: VSE/Alpha Skills PassionDef.Icon when available, then WorkBoxIcon tinted by PassionDef.color, then vanilla colored UI/Icons/PassionMinor/Major textures, then the vanilla gray work-box icons; no icon for None; VSE LabelCap is used for passion text. Scrollbar input is handled before the scroll view and drawing after it, so the horizontal bar stays interactive when the vertical bar appears; temporary MouseDown diagnostics log both bars. Colonist-bar order, hover-based drag targets, ghost/colors, simple/manual Work-tab fixes, return button, right-click max, selection, Recommend/Details, auto-recommend, save/load and resurrection are kept. No profiles, schedules, equipment or multi-pawn. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
